lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Slotted plate to wide middle plate, about 90 deg (incl 90.3). Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% and 13 stations put the line on the outer-skin apex within 0.01-0.07 mm; the inner skin is at +2.33 mm along the bisector. It is parallel to the fold. Line span is t 0..39.00 mm against a fold zone of -0.48..39.13 mm, so it covers the full width.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Middle plate to rounded tab, about 90 deg (incl 90.2), across the 24 mm neck. Sections at 25/50/75% and all stations put the line on the outer apex within 0.07 mm. It is parallel. Line span is t 0..24.08 mm against a fold zone of -0.24..24.50 mm. The end-plate width step and the reliefs sit beside the fold, and the line is not extended onto them.
